description: This file defines a PHP class Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Stdin that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Request. The class reads raw XML data from STDIN to construct an XML-RPC request, storing the raw XML and parsing it. It handles reading from php://stdin and provides a method to retrieve the raw request data.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Stdin
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Request to create an XML-RPC request object by reading raw XML data from STDIN.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that opens php://stdin, reads all data into a string, and attempts to load XML from it.

methods.name: getRawRequest
methods.description: Returns the raw XML string received via STDIN.
